data.description:
## Description

**What**: In-session verification of required-checks blocking behavior and thread-resolution escalation using real GitHub Ruleset infrastructure (configured by S5).
**Why**: SC4 and SC15 require in-session verification against live GitHub — these cannot be unit-tested and must be observed against the running Ruleset.
**Scope**:
- IN: Deliberate test PR with gh pr merge --auto queued; in-session confirmation of BLOCKED mergeStateStatus; confirmation all required checks must be green before auto-merge; thread-resolution negative test (deliberately seeded unresolvable thread); test branch cleanup after verification
- OUT: Happy-path E2E (in S3b); provision-ruleset.sh knobs (S5)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, a deliberate test PR with gh pr merge --auto queued confirms the PR remains in BLOCKED mergeStateStatus until each required check (CI tests, LLM review, validate-ci, platform-matrix legs, pipefail-strict, conversation-resolution) reports a green conclusion
  <- Satisfies: "Required-checks blocking is verified in-session on a real PR: a deliberate test PR with gh pr merge --auto queued; in-session checks confirm the PR remains in BLOCKED mergeStateStatus"
- When this story is complete, gh pr merge --squash rejects with not mergeable until all checks pass; the PR auto-merges only after the final check turns green
  <- Satisfies: "gh pr merge --squash rejects with not mergeable until all checks pass; the PR auto-merges only after the final check turns green"
- When this story is complete, a deliberately seeded blocking review thread on a test PR is resolved by the autonomous loop within the wait window, OR a thread the agent cannot programmatically resolve causes the loop to escalate to the user with the PR URL rather than spinning indefinitely
  <- Satisfies: "Thread-resolution path: a deliberately seeded blocking review thread on a test PR is resolved by the autonomous loop within the wait window, OR (negative test) a thread the agent cannot programmatically resolve causes the loop to escalate to the user with the PR URL"
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Test PR creation and cleanup must not interfere with real worktree sessions; use a dedicated test branch with a unique prefix
- [Testing] Requires live GitHub Ruleset configuration (require_conversation_resolution=true) already set by S5 — S4 depends on S5

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a plugin maintainer, I can verify required-checks blocking behavior and thread-resolution escalation in-session on a real GitHub PR
